heroHeadline: Cas12a2 'Shredder' Discovered; CRISPR Pipeline Expands with LDL-Targeting EDIT-401 and CTX310 US Expansion
heroSubtitle: May 2026: University of Utah reveals Cas12a2 — a new CRISPR system that destroys viral-infected and cancer cells without editing DNA, broadening the CRISPR toolkit beyond gene correction. Editas Medicine reports ≥90% LDL-C reduction in primates with EDIT-401 (PCSK9 CRISPR for familial hypercholesterolemia), targeting first-in-human trials in H2 2026. CRISPR Therapeutics expands CTX310 to US clinical sites and files pediatric Casgevy sBLA in H1 2026. Intellia scales commercial operations post-Phase 3 HAELO win.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, MHRA, NIH, peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, NEJM, Cell), ClinicalTrials.gov, and major science outlets. Clinical data reflects published peer-reviewed results only.
